name: Battleground
description: Battleground basketball circuit featuring competitive youth AAU programs in the Houston/Texas area.

name: Boys UA Rise
description: The Boys UA Rise provides elite travel teams with a league-style circuit at the 17U, 16U, and 15U levels. Teams compete in 10 regular season games that transition into a 32-team single-elimination championship bracket at the UAA Finals in July.

name: Girls UA Rise
description: The Girls UA Rise provides elite travel teams with a league-style circuit at the 17U, 16U, and 15U levels. Teams participate in 10 regular season games that transition into a 32-team single-elimination championship bracket at the UAA Finals in July.

name: Girls Under Armour Association (GUAA)
description: The Girls Under Armour Association (GUAA) is the premier girls basketball circuit featuring top AAU programs from across the nation. Teams compete in a league-style format at 17U, 16U, and 15U levels with 10 regular season games leading to a 32-team single-elimination championship bracket at UAA Finals.

name: OTR Circuit
description: On The Radar Circuit - premier grassroots basketball circuit featuring top AAU programs across the Southeast.

name: UA Future
description: UA Future is Under Armour's premier middle school basketball circuit for boys and girls in grades 6-8. The circuit models the format of the UAA and serves as the foundation for Under Armour's youth basketball platform, featuring events across 13 cities nationwide.

name: Under Armour Association (UAA)
description: The Boys Under Armour Association provides elite travel teams with a league-style circuit at the 17U, 16U and 15U level. Teams participate in 12 regular season games that transition into a single-elimination championship bracket at the UAA Finals in July to crown the UAA Champions.
